title: Smoky Syrian Pork Kebabs
description: A flavorful and tender kebab recipe inspired by Syrian cuisine, featuring smoky pork and a blend of exotic spices.

ingredients.name: syrian sumac
ingredients.notes: Add a tangy, slightly sour flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoky paprika, syrian sumac, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto the kebab skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the kebabs with the remaining spice mixture.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
